name: Herrera de Pisuerga (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Herrera de Pisuerga (two cauldrons on white).
history: The municipal flag of Herrera de Pisuerga was approved on 22 March 2002, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 10 May 2002; it is a square flag of proportion 1:1 with horizontal stripes of red and white and the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Herrera de Pisuerga arms — two cauldrons on white
